items.title: Local folder as sync target
items.text: Besides Nextcloud, WebDAV and SMB you can choose a folder on the device, for example the folder of a sync app like Syncthing. Pick the KMyMoney file in it as usual; export, backups and receipts work there just the same.

items.title: Databases from KMyMoney 5.2
items.text: The app now also reads and writes KMyMoney databases (SQLite) from KMyMoney 5.2, not only from 5.1. Budgets from a 5.2 database were missing entirely until now.

items.title: Categories as a tree
items.text: On narrow screens the category picker uses the full width and shows subcategories indented below their parent category.

items.title: Learned notification variants
items.text: After "OK" in the list of notifications, the app tells you when it learned a new variant of your bank's messages.

items.title: Transactions from push notifications
items.text: For banks without FinTS: KMySync learns from a transaction you entered by hand what your banking app's notifications look like, and proposes future payments as a list when you refresh – with payee, category and location.

items.title: KMyMoney database (SQLite)
items.text: Besides the .kmy file, the app can also read and write a KMyMoney database in SQLite format.

items.title: See changes to the KMyMoney file
items.text: After every export a line comparison shows what changed in the file. If it arrived damaged, the app restores the previous version.

items.title: More backups
items.text: The number of backups is adjustable, and the first backup of every month is kept permanently.

items.title: Sync mode "read .kmy, export CSV"
items.text: Accounts, schedules and portfolio come from the KMyMoney file, but writing happens only via CSV – for everyone who doesn't want the app to write their .kmy.

items.title: Payee is optional
items.text: As in KMyMoney: if the payee stays empty, the category takes its place.

items.title: Live search in the transaction list
items.text: Tapping the account name opens a search that filters the list as you type.

items.title: Watch: payees nearby
items.text: On the watch you can pick the payee from the places nearby.

items.title: New name: KMySync
items.text: The app is now called KMySync. Data, profiles and settings are kept.

items.title: "Test connection" checks everything
items.text: For Nextcloud, WebDAV and SMB the app checks the whole chain up to writing, renaming and deleting in the target folder, and shows a report with the reason if something fails.

items.title: Share portfolio rules
items.text: Learned recognition rules for PDF statements can be passed on and imported on another device.

items.title: Record securities
items.text: Buys, sells and dividends can be recorded and are written back to KMyMoney – with quantity, price, fees and taxes.

items.title: Read PDF statements
items.text: The app reads bank statements from PDF and learns for each bank where the values are; several documents can be read in one batch.

items.title: Multiple profiles
items.text: Separate data sets with their own accent color, their own server and their own backup.

items.title: Spanish
items.text: Spanish has been added as a third language.

items.title: PDF receipts
items.text: Receipts can also be attached as PDF documents.

items.title: Receipts as ZIP
items.text: The receipts of a filter can be exported as a ZIP file with meaningful file names, for example for your tax advisor.

items.title: Tags
items.text: Tags from KMyMoney are taken over, stored with the alias and suggested per payee.

items.title: Payees nearby
items.text: The closest payees appear at the top of the picker with a direction arrow.

items.title: The amount helps find the payee
items.text: If several payees are at the same place, the usual amount decides which one is meant.

items.title: Category from the payee
items.text: The first category is prefilled from the payee and follows when you change the payee.

items.title: Edited transactions reach KMyMoney
items.text: If you change a transaction that was already exported, the change also reaches the KMyMoney file with the next export.

items.title: Account groups
items.text: Your own groups like "Everyday" or "Savings" besides the account type; institutions and favorites from the .kmy are added as groups.

items.title: Sort and search accounts
items.text: Accounts can be sorted freely, and a search finds them quickly.

items.title: Search fields everywhere
items.text: Payee, account, category and place are picker and search field in one.

items.title: Multi-page receipts
items.text: A transaction can hold any number of receipt photos.

items.title: Edit receipts
items.text: Photos can be cropped, skewed invoices straightened, and brightness and contrast adjusted.

items.title: Built-in receipt viewer
items.text: Swipe, zoom and double-tap right in the app.

items.title: Complete backup
items.text: Data and settings in one ZIP file, encrypted if you like.

items.title: Connection check for SMB
items.text: A diagnosis goes through the whole chain and shows the result and duration of each step.

items.title: Choose the SMB port
items.text: Shares on a port other than 445 can be used too.

items.title: SMB wizard
items.text: The app searches for servers in the local network; then sign in, choose a share and save – without typing addresses.

items.title: Advance schedules
items.text: Executed or skipped occurrences are advanced in KMyMoney with the next .kmy export.

items.title: Portfolio in net worth
items.text: The portfolio value is included in the total and in the net worth history.

items.title: CSV in any language
items.text: KMyMoney CSV exports are read regardless of their language and number format.

items.title: Location on the map
items.text: The GPS location of a transaction can be set on a map.

items.title: Font size
items.text: The app's font size is adjustable.

items.title: Watch without connection
items.text: When the phone is away, the watch still records transactions and sends them later.

items.title: Transactions behind the category
items.text: Tapping a category in the analysis and in the budget shows its individual transactions.

items.title: Budget
items.text: Actual and planned per category, taken from KMyMoney or calculated from the history.

items.title: "Where does my money go?"
items.text: A pie chart by category, optionally including scheduled transactions.

items.title: Scheduled transactions
items.text: A separate view with balance strip, chart, "book now" and reminders for due items.

items.title: Receipt photos and widgets
items.text: Photos per transaction that are uploaded to the server, and widgets for the home screen.

items.title: Portfolio
items.text: Securities with buys, sells, dividends and prices, plus a portfolio view with a pie chart.

items.title: Number format and currency
items.text: Number format and currency symbol can be chosen, in the app and on the watch.

items.title: The first version
items.text: Record cash on the go – by hand, by voice or on the watch – and transfer it to your own KMyMoney file.
